headlines.snippet: Natanel Kron was killed in a terrorist attack at a spring in Benjamin; the perpetrator was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital. A terrorist opened fire on people at a spring near Neve Tzuf, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Kron, a father of six from Alon Shvut, was critically wounded and later died at the hospital. After an extensive manhunt, commandos apprehended the terrorist in a Ramallah hospital after he was wounded by IDF tracker fire. Approximately an hour later, a second terrorist attempting a ramming attack in the northern West Bank was neutralized.
